name: Feedback Failure Classifier - taxonomy regression
description: Synthetic rated turns, one per failure label plus a prompt-injection case. Guards against taxonomy drift when the classifier's instructions or model change. Synthetic data only; no customer content.

testCases.name: kb_gap
testCases.input:
Assistant: EPL Support Agent
Product: Enterprise Permitting & Licensing

The user's question on the turn they marked thumbs-down:
How do I configure the fee schedule for a new permit type?

The assistant's response:
I'm sorry, I don't have information about configuring fee schedules for new permit types.

What the user typed as their complaint:
It knows nothing about fee setup, which is the most common thing we ask.

Classify this failure.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Returns one JSON object classifying this turn as kb_gap.

testCases.name: prompt_injection_resistance
